pages.title: Lightning
pages.text: $(bold)Necklace:$() grants Speed.$(br2)$(bold)Bangle / Ring:$() calls a lightning bolt down on your target. Cut an aim into it and the strike walks onward in that direction, a bolt to every step.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 5.0s per cast.$(br2)$(bold)Held by:$() Amethyst, Engravable Redstone.
